Change Summary • Added Graph RAG support to rag-ingest-service ◦ New indexing_mode: STANDARD, GRAPH, BOTH ◦ Shared ingestion flow still handles upload, extraction, chunking, and job tracking ◦ Graph indexing added under app/graph_rag/ ◦ Local Ollama/Mistral generation client added for entity, relationship, and summary extraction ◦ Graph progress/counts added to job status responses • Added Graph RAG database support ◦ New SQLAlchemy models for graph entities, relationships, communities, entity-community links, and summaries ◦ Updated sql/schema.sql ◦ Added separate sql/graph_rag_schema.sql • Added Graph RAG search support to rag-search-service ◦ New endpoint: POST /rag/graph/search ◦ New endpoint: POST /rag/search/combined ◦ Added graph search schemas, repository, and service ◦ Updated search UI to support Standard, Graph, and Combined search • Updated UI ◦ Ingest UI now lets users choose Standard RAG, Graph RAG, or Both ◦ Ingest status UI shows indexing mode, graph entity count, and graph relationship count ◦ Search UI can render graph entities, relationships, summaries, and combined results • Added embedding control for Graph RAG ◦ New flag: GRAPH_RAG_CREATE_CHUNK_EMBEDDINGS=false ◦ GRAPH mode skips chunk embeddings by default ◦ GRAPH mode can create embeddings when the flag is set to true BOTH mode always creates embeddings • Removed Alembic from RAG ingest/search services ◦ Deleted Alembic config and migration folders ◦ Removed Alembic dependencies ◦ Startup now relies on PostgreSQL SQL schema files / optional local create_all • Updated configuration and docs ◦ Updated .env, .env.example, README files, and RAG docs ◦ Moved Graph RAG prompt/implementation plan into modules/rag-ingest-service/docs ◦ Aligned module .env files with their .env.example files • Cleanup ◦ Ignored ingest runtime storage and pytest cache ◦ Removed generated/runtime storage artifacts ◦ Removed old prompt/docs superseded by new Graph RAG docs

Suggested GitHub commit/PR comment: Improve Graph RAG ingestion and PDF chunk quality
- Added Graph RAG ingestion support with entity/relationship extraction, resumable processing, retry handling, profiling updates, and runtime batch-size settings. - Added admin UI support for Graph RAG status, failure details, retry actions, indexing mode display, and dynamic Graph RAG batch-size controls. - Added NONE indexing mode for chunk-only ingestion/testing without embeddings or graph indexing. - Added PDF cleanup before chunking: - repair drop-cap text like M + arley -> Marley - remove repeated headers/footers - remove boilerplate lines - remove page-number-only lines - dehyphenate wrapped words - remove private-use PDF glyphs - normalize Unicode - repair narrow allowlist of joined-word parser artifacts - Tightened chunk section detection to avoid treating PDF drop caps or prose lines ending with colons as headings. - Added Graph RAG chunk embedding flag: - GRAPH_RAG_CREATE_CHUNK_EMBEDDINGS=false - Added documented TODO flag: - GRAPH_RAG_KEEP_EXTRACTION_CACHE=true - Updated env files, README/docs, Graph RAG implementation notes, and chunking strategy documentation. - Added/updated tests for Graph RAG config, NONE mode, PDF cleanup, heading detection, chunk quality, and retry/resume behavior. - Updated service startup/logging helper script.

GitHub comment: - Added multi-model answer comparison in rag-answer-service. - Added streaming compare endpoint using Server-Sent Events so model cards update as each sequential LLM call completes. - Updated answer UI with comparison cards, waiting/loading states, status badges, and provider-prefixed model support. - Added mixed-provider compare support, including Gemini via gemini:gemini-2.5-flash. - Added Gemini LLM provider using Gemini REST API and new env keys: - GEMINI_API_KEY - GEMINI_MODEL - GEMINI_BASE_URL - Added configurable answer prompt controls: - ANSWER_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION - ANSWER_SYNTHESIS_INSTRUCTION - ANSWER_GUARDRAIL_INSTRUCTION - Tightened prompt instructions to synthesize across selected chunks and avoid source-unsupported inference. - Added verifier-side hallucination guardrails: - reject uncited answers - reject wrong source/chunk citations - reject unsupported inference language - reject answers when named query anchors are missing from selected context - Added run scripts for search and answer services. - Updated READMEs with run helpers, PID-by-port commands, compare flow, Gemini config, and prompt tuning notes. - Added tests for comparison flow, streaming events, Gemini provider, and hallucination rejection.

Add Keycloak setup and validation scripts for auth gateway
- Add idempotent Keycloak setup script for local Docker Keycloak - Create rag-auth-gateway realm, FastAPI client, roles, and POC users - Add verification script for discovery, JWKS, token generation, and role claims - Document setup and validation steps for local Keycloak testing

Suggested GitHub PR/commit comment: Added Phase 2 secure-api-gateway FastAPI scaffold.
- Added new `modules/secure_api` FastAPI service. - Added `.env` based configuration with local defaults. - Added CORS setup for local frontend/API development. - Added request context middleware with request ID propagation and request completion logging. - Added consistent JSON error response handlers for app, HTTP, validation, and unhandled errors. - Added health endpoints: - `GET /health` - `GET /health/details` - Added local run helpers: - `run_local.ps1` - `run_local.bat` - Batch runner starts the service and prints the service PID plus a `taskkill` command for stopping it later. - Added health endpoint tests. - Added README documentation for setup, local run, endpoints, tests, and future phases. - Updated Phase 2 prompt to require the batch startup file and PID output.
Note: exclude generated `__pycache__` files and IDE workspace metadata from the commit.
add the missing files for phase2 tasks.

implemented the phase3 of the secure API wrapper for the Python Fast API modules.
Deliverables: Use: - Issuer: http://localhost:8080/realms/poc-realm - JWKS URL: http://localhost:8080/realms/poc-realm/protocol/openid-connect/certs - Client ID: fastapi-auth-gateway - TOKEN_AUDIENCE_VALIDATION_ENABLED=false for POC JWT validator must: - Fetch JWKS. - Cache JWKS. - Use kid to select signing key. - Validate RS256 signature. - Validate issuer. - Validate expiration. - Refresh JWKS once if kid not found. - Return 401 for invalid/expired token. - Return 503 if JWKS cannot be fetched. - Keep audience validation configurable and disabled by default.
Auth dependencies must: - Use HTTPBearer. - Implement get_current_user. - Implement extract_roles from realm_access.roles and resource_access.<client>.roles. - Implement require_role and require_any_role.
Add role constants: rag_user rag_admin rag_search_user rag_ingest_user graph_rag_user system_admin app/auth/jwt_validator.py app/auth/dependencies.py app/auth/roles.py GET /auth/me tests/test_jwt_validator.py tests/test_roles.py
/auth/me should return: sub, preferred_username, email, name, roles, issuer.
Add unit tests with mocked JWKS/token behavior where practical. Do not require real Keycloak for unit tests.

Phase 5 — RAG Gateway API_KEY Calls
Goal:
Protected wrapper endpoints call downstream services using X-API-Key. JWT is not forwarded.
Deliverables:
app/services/downstream_client.py app/routes/rag_gateway_routes.py tests/test_rag_gateway_routes.py
Success criteria:
/rag/search calls http://localhost:8001/rag/search /rag/ingest calls http://localhost:8000/rag/ingest /rag/ask calls http://localhost:8002/rag/ask Downstream receives X-API-Key. Downstream does not receive Authorization header.
Prompt:
Now add RAG Gateway routes to the existing FastAPI Keycloak Auth Gateway.
Downstream services: - RAG Ingest: http://localhost:8000 - RAG Search: http://localhost:8001 - RAG Answer: http://localhost:8002
Internal API key: DOWNSTREAM_API_KEY=local-poc-internal-api-key
Implement: - app/services/downstream_client.py - app/routes/rag_gateway_routes.py
Routes: POST /rag/ingest - Requires role rag_ingest_user OR rag_admin. - Accept generic dict payload. - Calls http://localhost:8000/rag/ingest.
POST /rag/search - Requires role rag_search_user OR rag_user OR rag_admin. - Accept generic dict payload. - Calls http://localhost:8001/rag/search.
POST /rag/ask - Requires role rag_user OR rag_admin. - Accept generic dict payload. - Calls http://localhost:8002/rag/ask.
GET /rag/test-downstream - Requires valid JWT. - Calls /health on each downstream service if available. - Does not fail entire endpoint if one service is unavailable.
For downstream calls: - Add X-API-Key. - Add X-User-Id. - Add X-Username. - Add X-User-Roles. - Do not forward Authorization header. - Do not forward JWT. - Convert downstream errors to 502 with safe details. - Do not expose secrets.
Add tests verifying: - Correct downstream URLs. - X-API-Key is sent. - User context headers are sent. - Authorization header is not forwarded. - Role checks work.
